title: fremya lucens
intro: Fremya lucens, commonly known as the 'Mountain Mint', is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family. It has been traditionally used to aid in digestion and relieve symptoms of nausea, diarrhea, and stomach discomfort, providing numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Fremya lucens are attributed to its ability to calm the digestive system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
